title: Exercise promotes neurogenesis in the hippocampus
statement: Regular aerobic exercise stimulates the production of new neurons in the adult hippocampus, improving learning and memory.
mechanism: Exercise increases brain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF) levels, which promotes neuronal survival, growth, and differentiation in the dentate gyrus.
predictions: Higher BDNF after exercise correlates with improved spatial memory

experiments.readout: Hippocampal volume and memory test scores
